task: Consistent-hash ring (ae.ring HashRing/Hasher/Rebalance) with weighted vnodes, replica preference lists, bounded-load assignment and rebalance diffs
reasoning_summary: Ring stores sorted unsigned-ordered points (hash XOR MIN_VALUE) and owners; lookups binary-search with wraparound. Table-hasher tests pin exact positions, real-hash tests check minimal movement, balance, weights, replicas and bounded load. Two test expectations were wrong on the first run and were corrected.
